newsitem.title: USA: FedEx, U.S. post ad dispute to face FTC-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: FedEx, U.S. post ad dispute to face FTC-WSJ.

text.p: A complaint the U.S. postal service filed against Federal Express will go before the Federal Trade Commission after an industry arbitration panel said it was unable to resolve the issue, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.
The U.S. Postal Service protested a Federal Express radio advertisement, which warned consumers not to believe the Postal Services' Priority Mail pitches, the paper said.
The dispute was taken before the National Advertising Division of the Council of Better Business Bureaus, which has passed the case along to the FTC, the Journal said.
